lessons.title: 9. NULL & CASE Statements
lessons.description: Add a `price_tier` column with `CASE`: `Budget` when `price` is below 50, otherwise `Premium`. The test checks that the result has at least 5 rows and a column named `price_tier`.
lessons.starter_code:
-- TODO: add a price_tier column: 'Budget' under 50, otherwise 'Premium'
SELECT name, price FROM products WHERE 0;
lessons.solution_code: SELECT name, price, CASE WHEN price < 50 THEN 'Budget' ELSE 'Premium' END AS price_tier FROM products;

source.name: SQLite official documentation (sqlite.org) — The CASE expression — WHEN/THEN/ELSE branches

learning_objectives: Handle missing data: NULL is not a value but a marker for 'no data'
Branch per row with CASE WHEN ... THEN ... ELSE ... END
